$comment: What mm_core's parseAmount and formatAmountWords must give, written by hand: the vectors are the contract (docs/roadmap/amount-parser.md). parse: each input, read in a single amount field ('field') or in free text ('text'), gives expected: whole paisa, 'ambiguous' (two readings, or a word not to guess at) or null (no amount, negative, above max_paisa, or not whole paisa). words: what formatAmountWords writes for an amount in Urdu script, Roman Urdu and English; parseAmount in a field reads each back. The words come from contracts/amount_lexicon.json, which a native speaker has not yet reviewed. tool/contracts/generate.py --check validates the shape and bounds, and that every input passes the Unicode guard; Dart runs every vector (packages/mm_core/test/contract/amount_contract_test.dart), and the Deno and website ports will (work item 6). Every addition to the lexicon needs a vector here.
